api_reference.api.api_functions.get_component.descript: Access a player-owned entity by its **immutable id** (e.g. `"solar_3"`, `"outpost_home"`). The id is auto-generated on creation and never changes: use this in scripts that need to outlive renames. To look up by display name (mutable), use `get_component_by_name(name)`. Returns `None` if no entity has the given id.
Look up any addressable player-owned component (machine or outpost) by its display name. Names default to the entity's id but can be freely renamed from the Computer System tab; uniqueness is enforced across the shared rename namespace. Custom Panels share that namespace but are not components, so they are not returned here. Mutable: `get_component(id)` is the stable form for long-running scripts. Returns `None` if no component has the given name.
Component (machine or outpost), or None if no component by that name exists
api_reference.api.api_functions.get_pipe.description: Look up an infrastructure pipe by id. Returns a live read-only `Pipe` handle, or `None` if no pipe by that id exists.
api_reference.api.api_functions.list_pipes.description: List every infrastructure pipe currently laid (complete or in-progress) as live read-only `Pipe` handles.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.actionresult.messag: Player-readable explanation of the exact command outcome. Suitable for logs and player-facing diagnostics.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.actionresult.status: Stable result code for scripts to check. `.message` explains what happened.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.alienterminal.guess: Test a list of exactly 15 whole-number digits in the **1-5** range and return `GuessResult`. Exact-position matches are removed first; `.misplaced` then counts shared remaining occurrences without over-counting duplicates. Wrong argument or element types raise `TypeError`; wrong length, fractional values, or out-of-range digits raise `ValueError`.
Candidate list of 15 whole-number digits, each 1-5
World coordinates `[x, y]` the specimen was collected from.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.analyzeinfo.distanc: Straight-line distance in meters from this outpost (set at collect time).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.analyzeinfo.fragmen: Discovered fragment id (e.g. `"gw_cranial_plate"`). Use as the inventory key for the resulting sample: Bio Orders ask for fragments by this id.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.analyzeinfo.name.de: Display name of the analyzed fragment.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.analyzeinfo.require: Required reagents to extract a sample: dict `{reagent_id: qty}`. Iterate `.items()` and call `lab.load(rid, qty)` for each pair, then `lab.extract()`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.analyzer.read.descr: Read a list of exactly five string tokens and return the single token they were expanded from. A non-list argument or non-string element raises `TypeError`; the wrong length or an unrecognized group raises `ValueError`.
Completed `AnalyzeInfo`, or `None` when analysis was rejected.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.analyzeresult.messa: Player-readable explanation of the analysis outcome.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.arbiter.board.descr: The 9 board cells as a list, index 0-8 row-major. Each cell is "" (empty), "you", or "arbiter".
api_reference.api.api_object_types.arbiter.new_game.de: Start a fresh 3×3 game on an empty board; you move first. After a finished game this call pauses about half a second before the next board is ready.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.arbiter.play.descri: Place your mark in a whole-number cell in the **0-8** range (row-major), then the Arbiter responds. Three marks in a row, column, or diagonal wins. A non-number cell raises `TypeError`; a non-finite, fractional, or out-of-range cell raises `ValueError` before game state is considered.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.arbiter.restart.des: Abandon any game in progress and start fresh; you move first. Abandoning a game mid-play counts as a non-win and resets your current-run streak to 0. Like new_game(), it pauses about half a second between games.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.arbiter.result.desc: Current game outcome: "ongoing", "win", "loss", "draw", or "no_game" (no game started yet).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.arbiter.streak.desc: Consecutive wins in the current script run. Resets to 0 on a loss, draw, abandonment, or fresh script run.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.arbiter.target.desc: The consecutive-win count needed to complete the contract.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.arbiter.token.descr: The passcode to transmit: a non-empty string once streak() reaches target(), otherwise an empty string.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.archive.cols.descri: Number of columns in the grid.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.archive.flip.descri: Reveal and return the word at a whole-number grid cell. Wrong argument types raise `TypeError`; fractional, non-finite, or out-of-bounds coordinates raise `ValueError`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.archive.rows.descri: Number of rows in the grid.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.battery.holders.des: List of every Battery Holder currently mounted on the vehicle. Empty for the Rover (sealed battery).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.battery.wh.descript: Current charge in Wh (across all batteries).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.beatthesystemcontra: The alien Arbiter. It takes an immediate win, otherwise blocks your immediate win, otherwise prefers centre, then corners, then edges; tied choices are random.

api_reference.api.api_object_types.biocasterrecipe.tie: Derived production tier of this forge recipe.

api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioorder.biome.desc: Biome the required fragments belong to (e.g. `"frozen"`). Orders for biomes you have no outpost in can't be filled yet.
Per-fragment delivery progress: dict `{fragment_id: count}`, shared across every Bio Exchange serving this order. Compare against `.requires` to see what's left to deliver.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioorder.id.descrip: Stable Bio Order id (e.g. `"bio_order_03"`). Pass to `bio_exchange.set_order(id)` to make this the active Bio Order.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioorder.in_transit: Samples committed to delivery as `{fragment_id: count}`, shared across every Exchange serving this order. Includes qualifying samples already staged in an Exchange input and timed deliveries underway. A sample stays counted while `deliver()` moves it into delivery, then leaves after completion or when staged for refund in `self.output`. Query the order again for current values. `.percent` counts completed deliveries only.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioorder.name.descr: Display name of the Bio Order (e.g. `"Cryophyte Spore Panel"`).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioorder.percent.de: Overall completion: **0-100**, samples delivered divided by total required across every fragment.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioorder.required_g: Required gene sets for geothermal orders as `{fragment_id: [attribute_id, ...]}`, or `None` for other orders. Each fragment must carry exactly its listed **1-3** genes. Engineer it with the DNA Sequencer; raw fragments and fragments with extra genes are not accepted.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioorder.requires.d: The fragment shopping list: dict `{fragment_id: count}`. Iterate `.items()` to see what to deliver and how many of each.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioorder.reward.des: Credits paid when every requirement is met. Paid once: orders are one-time.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioorder.status.des: Status relative to this Bio Exchange: `"available"` (not currently selected here), `"active"` (selected here), or `"complete"` (completed globally). Global completion takes priority over selection; an available order may already have delivery progress.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioorder.target_glo: Coastal infusion orders only: the exact glow `[r,g,b]` (0-255) the required fragment must be infused to via the Bio Luminizer. `None` for non-coastal orders. `deliver()` only matches a Luminous fragment whose glow equals this.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.bioscanresult.messa: Player-readable explanation of the biological scan outcome.
Completed `LifeFormScanResult`, or `None` when the scan was rejected.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.blueprintplanresult: Newly created blueprint ids. Empty for every outcome except `"ok"`.
Player-readable explanation of the exact planning outcome.
Stable planning outcome. Branch on this field before reading `.blueprint_ids`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.broadcastinfo.age_s: Simulation seconds since this broadcast, sampled when `latest_info()` is read or `wait_broadcast()` resumes. Uses the same time base as `sleep()` and `clock.elapsed_seconds()`; pausing the simulation freezes the age. `None` means the timestamp is missing or invalid. The returned age is a snapshot.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.broadcastinfo.sende: Who published this broadcast, or `None` if the saved broadcast has no sender information.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.broadcastinfo.value: A copy of this broadcast's value, including `None` if that was the value published. From `latest_info()` it is the latest value; from `wait_broadcast()` it is the first publication captured by that wait.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.buildingref.id.desc: Stable component id. Use with `get_component(id)` to reach the full machine API (counts, recipes, materials, etc.).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.buildingref.name.de: Display name when this ref was returned (e.g. `"Iron Ore Bin"`). For fresh names or live machine state, call `get_component(id)`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.buildingref.outpost: Snapshot back-reference to the owning outpost as an `OutpostRef` (or `None` if the link can't be resolved).
Id of the outpost this building is deployed at.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.buildingref.positio: World coordinates as `[x, y]`. For most buildings this is the deploy anchor; doesn't move.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.buildingref.powered: `True` when the building's power toggle was on as this ref was returned. For live power/production reads, call `get_component(id)`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.buildingref.type_id: Machine type id, e.g. `"storage_bin"`, `"smelter"`, `"solar_generator"`. Stable forever; use this for branching logic.
The recovered analyzer device: collapses a group of five tokens into the single token they were expanded from.
Whole-number count of five-fold wrapping layers applied to the transmission.
Credit reward for completing this contract.
The scrambled transmission: a list of single-character tokens.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cargo.capacity.desc: Total units the vehicle can carry in its integrated hold or installed Cargo Racks.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cargo.compact.descr: On a Pioneer, consolidate equal item ids into the fewest installed Portable Bins that can hold them. Property-distinct variants remain intact, and the planner preserves the fullest compatible bins to minimize physical movement. Requires **Auto Feeders**, waits for time proportional to the units repositioned, and holds the Pioneer stationary as a material endpoint during that cycle. This does not change which bin `send()` drains first.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cargo.count.descrip: Total units currently carried by the vehicle.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cargo.discard.descr: Permanently jettison everything in the whole-number, zero-based `rack_index`. On a Rover, which has no racks, `self.cargo.discard(0)` addresses the integrated hold. An already-empty hold or rack finishes immediately; destroying cargo takes **1 hour** and pauses the script. This is the vehicle cargo destruction API.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cargo.discard.rack_: Whole-number zero-based index among mounted Cargo Racks (0 = the integrated hold on a Rover)
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cargo.full.descript: `True` when the integrated hold or every installed cargo bin is full. A Pioneer without installed bins is also full.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cargo.racks.descrip: List of every Cargo Rack currently mounted. Empty for the Rover.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cargo.stacks.descri: Snapshot of every property-distinct `ItemStack` in the vehicle's cargo. Use this to distinguish variants that share an item id.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.catalogedcreature.f: The exact feed item this creature accepts. Stage at least `.revive_feed_required` units in the Habitat before revival.

The Feed Maker recipe id that produces `.feed_item_id`. The matching recipe must still be unlocked through Bio Orders; find its current `Recipe` in `feed_maker.list_recipes()` for ingredient quantities.
The five analyzed fragment ids that completed this creature's catalog entry, in biome order.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.catalogedcreature.n: Player-facing creature name. Use for readable output; use `.creature_id` for automation.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.catalogedcreature.r: Rarity tier: `"common" | "uncommon" | "rare" | "legendary"`. Rarity determines the revival reagent quantities.
Minimum whole feed units that must be staged in the Habitat after selecting this creature and before `revive()` can start.
Exact revival shopping list as `{reagent_id: quantity}` for this creature's rarity. Stage every listed amount through the Habitat's `reagents` input.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.catalogedfragment.b: Biome where this fragment is found: `"frozen"` for Nocturna's starter biome. Filter the result list by biome to scope to a specific outpost's biome.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.catalogedfragment.c: World coordinates `[x, y]` where the fragment can be collected. Pass to `bio_collector.collect(coords)` from the Bio Collector at the matching outpost.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.catalogedfragment.f: Stable fragment id (e.g. `"gw_cranial_plate"`). Matches the keys in `BioOrder.requires`, so this is what scripts use to plan order fulfillment.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.catalogedfragment.n: Player-facing fragment name (e.g. `"Beak"`). Use for readable output; use `.fragment_id` when matching `BioOrder.requires` or moving the item.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.catalogedfragment.r: Rarity tier: `"common" | "uncommon" | "rare" | "legendary"`. Inherited from the parent creature.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.accelerant_rem: Hours of Growth Accelerant effect remaining. Each applied unit adds **8 hours**; reads **0** when none remains.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.accelerated.de: `True` while any Growth Accelerant dose remains on this cell. `False` when undosed or fully drained.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.fertilized.des: `True` while any Fertilizer dose remains on this cell. `False` when undosed or fully drained.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.fertilizer_rem: Hours of Fertilizer effect remaining. Each applied unit adds **8 hours**; reads **0** when none remains.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.fertilizer_tie: Active Fertilizer tier: **1**, **2**, or **3**. Reads **0** when no Fertilizer remains.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.forage.descrip: Whole **forage** banked by this crop. It rises with visible growth while requirements are met, includes diversity and field bonuses, and freezes at `growth == 1.0`. The Harvester moves as much as Inventory can hold and leaves any remainder on the crop. A Crop Automator moves what fits in its output, discards the remainder, and clears the cell; a completely full output blocks the job without changing the crop. Forage feeds Wildlife production and Plant Terraformer batches.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.growth.descrip: Crop growth progress **0-1**. **1.0** means ready to harvest. Advances only while every requirement is met and pauses (never regresses) otherwise. Clearing the crop returns it to **0**; a partial Harvester harvest leaves the crop mature at **1.0** with its remaining forage.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.id.description: Sector id, e.g. `"E13"` (row letter A-H + column 1-24). Parse it to compute the four orthogonal neighbors yourself: the grid hands you no `neighbors()` helper.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.lit.descriptio: `True` while the cell has an active 24-hour Harvester light treatment or a powered Grow Lamp covers it. Satisfies the **Light** requirement; **Shade** plants need this `False`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.manual_light_r: Hours remaining on the Harvester-applied light treatment, in the **0-24** range. This excludes Grow Lamp coverage. Each successful `light()` resets it to **24 hours**, replacing any remaining time.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.manual_salt_re: Hours remaining on the Harvester-applied salt treatment, in the **0-24** range. This excludes Dispenser coverage. Each successful `dispense_salt()` resets it to **24 hours**, replacing any remaining time.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.manual_water_r: Hours remaining on the Harvester-applied water treatment, in the **0-24** range. This excludes Sprinkler coverage. Each successful `water()` resets it to **24 hours**, replacing any remaining time.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.plant.descript: Species id of the planted flora, such as `"sunpetal"`, or `None` when the cell has no plant. This is the species id, not the `"seed_sunpetal"` item id. An empty cell may still contain a provider or uncollected item, so also check `.status`. It matches `SeedRecipe.species` and the species part of `"seed:<species>"`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.salted.descrip: `True` while the cell has an active 24-hour Harvester salt treatment, or while a powered, supplied Dispenser covers it. Satisfies the **Salt** requirement. A plant pauses when neither source is active.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.status.descrip: What occupies the sector or what its crop is doing: `"unknown"` until natural ground is scanned, `"empty"` (bare plantable ground), `"item"` (an uncollected surface item), `"base"` (the Harvester depot), `"provider"` (field equipment), `"growing"`, `"stalled"`, or `"mature"`. Player-created plants and providers remain visible. Only `"empty"` accepts planting or deployment.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cell.watered.descri: `True` while the cell has an active 24-hour Harvester water treatment, or while a powered, supplied Sprinkler covers it. Satisfies the **Water** requirement. A plant pauses when neither source is active.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.chamberfragment.fra: The geothermal fragment id loaded in the chamber (e.g. `"gw_cardiac_node"`).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.chamberfragment.gen: The genes the chambered fragment currently carries (e.g. `["cold_tolerance", "pressure_tolerance"]`). Same as calling `genes()`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.chamberfragment.nam: Player-facing name of the geothermal fragment loaded in the chamber.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.chamberfragment.spl: `True` after this fragment has used its one safe splice. Calling `splice()` again destroys it. `False` means the fragment can still be engineered once.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.chambersample.fragm: The coastal fragment id loaded in the chamber (e.g. `"gw_caudal_fin"`).
The sample's current glow `[r,g,b]` (0-255): the dim start color before tuning. Read it, the order's `target_glow`, and `lamp_signature(...)` to solve the lamp settings.
Player-facing name of the coastal fragment loaded in the chamber.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.coldbootcontract.pr: The artifact's bytecode: a list of whole numbers. Copy it before running: `memory = list(program)`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.coldbootcontract.re: Credit reward for completing this contract.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.collectresult.colle: Whole-number units committed to drone cargo by this call.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.collectresult.item_: Stable id of the collected material, or `None` when no material was collected.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.collectresult.messa: Player-readable explanation of the exact collection outcome.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.commandresult.comma: Consumed `ScriptCommand`, or `None` when the queue was empty.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.commandresult.messa: Player-readable explanation of the command dequeue result.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.commandresult.statu: `"ok"` when a command was consumed, otherwise `"empty"`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.commsmessage.id.des: Monotonic message id assigned by the Signal Bus.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.commsmessage.sender: Script owner id that sent the message.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.commsmessage.tick.d: Game tick when the message was sent.
JSON-safe message value: `None`, boolean, number, string, list, or dict with string keys.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.construction.kind.d: What's being built or removed. One of `"pipe"` / `"power_line"` / `"gas_bridge"` / `"liquid_bridge"` / `"power_bridge"` / `"deconstruct"` / `"outpost"` / `"thermal_cap"` / `"water_pump"` / `"oil_pump"` / `"exotic_gas_cap"` / `"exotic_spring_tap"` / `"mining_drill"` / `"mining_drill_industrial"` / `"mining_drill_heavy"`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.construction.medium: Physical utility layer: `"gas"`, `"liquid"`, or `"power"`; `None` for point structures. Pipe jobs keep `.kind == "pipe"`, so use this field to distinguish Gas Pipe from Liquid Pipe. Deconstruction reports the target's utility layer.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.construction.positi: Tile-aligned world coordinates as a `Position` snapshot (`.x`, `.y`). Pioneer drives here to start/resume construction.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.construction.progre: Build completion **0-1** when this `Construction` snapshot was returned. Useful especially for paused work: sort by progress to resume the most-completed first; re-query construction lists for fresh progress.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.construction.requir: Units of `.required_item` needed to accept this job. Most single-piece jobs need 1; deconstruction needs 0.
Item id the Pioneer must carry before executing this job, or `None` for deconstruction and paused jobs that have already started.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.constructormodule.e: Pending, active, or paused blueprint id from the construction_blueprint queue.

Execute a Plan Mode construction or deconstruction blueprint. Drive the Pioneer within interaction range of `blueprint.position`, then pass a blueprint id from `get_component("construction_blueprint").pending_constructions()`, `.active_constructions()`, or `.paused_constructions()`. Yielding. One Pioneer performs one field action at a time. Stop, power loss, leaving the site, rescue, or removing the Constructor Module pauses paid work without losing progress or materials. The owning Pioneer can rejoin active work, including after save/load; another Pioneer cannot steal an owned job.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.contract.reward.des: Credit reward for completing this contract.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.contractscript.cont: The contract object with ID, name, reward, and contract-specific API.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.contractscript.name: Script name.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.coredevice.recovere: How many of the 10 cores are locked in the current script run. A fresh run starts at 0.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.coredevice.submit.b: The rebuilt core as a list of whole-number bytes in the **0-255** range
api_reference.api.api_object_types.coredevice.submit.d: Submit a rebuilt core for whole-number slot `index` (0-9). Wrong container or element types raise `TypeError`; a fractional or out-of-range index, wrong list length, or numeric value outside the **0-255** range raises `ValueError`. A rejected submission does not lock the slot.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.coredevice.target.d: The number of cores you must recover to complete the contract: 10.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.coredevice.token.de: The passcode to transmit: a non-empty string once recovered() reaches target(), otherwise an empty string.
The 10 damaged cores, as a list of byte lists. A byte destroyed in transit reads as None: recover it from the construction rules.
The reconstruction device: submit your rebuilt cores to it. See CoreDevice.
Credit reward for completing this contract.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.corruptedarchivecon: Credit reward for completing this contract.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.countresult.count.d: Whole-number entries or units affected by the command.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.countresult.message: Player-readable explanation of the count operation.
`"ok"` when one or more entries changed, `"no_op"` when nothing changed, or a command-specific rejection such as `"invalid_channel"` or `"invalid_key"`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cropjob.blocker.des: Exact physical blocker, or `None` while working or queued.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cropjob.item_id.des: Requested seed or treatment item, or `None` for harvest jobs.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cropjob.progress.de: Completed fraction from **0-1**. Pending jobs read **0**.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cropjobresult.colle: Whole Forage units committed to the output bin by a harvest. Always **0** otherwise.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cropjobresult.disca: Whole Forage units a harvest could not fit and threw away. Non-zero only with `"partial"`; the cell is cleared either way.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cropjobresult.item_: Requested seed or treatment item, or `None` for harvest and empty results.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cropjobresult.job_i: Completed job id, or `None` when empty.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cropjobresult.messa: Player-readable explanation of the terminal outcome.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cropjobresult.secto: Completed target sector, or `None` when empty.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.cropjobresult.statu: Terminal job outcome, or `"empty"` when no completed result was waiting.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.crosstalkcontract.i: First intercepted signal: a string of letters with 0s and 1s scattered through. Some bits are decoys.
Second intercepted signal: same shape as input_x.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.crosstalkcontract.m: Minimum palindrome length for a bit to count: a bit qualifies only if the letters mirror to this span centred on it.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.crosstalkcontract.r: Credit reward for completing this contract.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.datatablet.cols.des: Number of columns in the grid.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.datatablet.probe.de: Probe a whole-number cell and return a `ProbeResult` with `.char` and whole-number `.distance`. Wrong argument types raise `TypeError`; fractional or out-of-bounds coordinates raise `ValueError`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.datatablet.rows.des: Number of rows in the grid.
Credit reward for completing this contract.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.discardresult.messa: Player-readable explanation of the discard outcome.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.discardresult.reque: Whole-number units requested or observed for destruction.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dockslot.count.desc: Units currently stored in this slot.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dockslot.index.desc: Zero-based slot index (**0-4**): stable across calls.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dockslot.item_id.de: Item id currently occupying this slot, or `None` if the slot is empty.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.driftingsignalcontr: Credit reward for completing this contract.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.drillmodule.hardnes: Max mineral hardness this drill can extract (**1** basic, **3** Industrial, **4** Heavy). A stale captured module reference raises `ReferenceError`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.drillmodule.speed_m: Drill-time multiplier (**1.0** basic, **0.75** Industrial, **0.6** Heavy: lower is faster). A stale captured module reference raises `ReferenceError`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronebattery.capaci: Total charge capacity in Wh. Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have an electric powertrain.
Current charge in Wh across mounted Battery Packs. Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have an electric powertrain.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronebattery.percen: Charge as a fraction **0-1** (`level / capacity`). Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have an electric powertrain.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronecargo.capacity: Total physical capacity summed over every container: each mounted Cargo Pod (Small **100**, Medium **250**, Large **500**) plus the Bio Extractor's **25 t** chamber. Shield Plating halves each pod's capacity.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronecargo.contents: Dict mapping `item_id` → unit count for every material currently in cargo. Iterate with `.keys()` / `.items()`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronecargo.count.de: Total units across every Cargo Pod plus the Bio Extractor chamber.
Permanently destroy up to whole-number `count` units from this drone's cargo. This jettison needs no station and a drained pod unlatches for a new material.
Optional property dict, matched as a subset by default. Omitted or `None` matches any properties; use `None` with `property_match="exact"` to select propertyless items only.
Optional selection mode: any, subset, or exact
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronecargo.full.des: `True` when `count() >= capacity()`. A drone may still be unable to load a new item type when every pod is committed, even if `full()` is `False`; use `space_for(item_id)` for a specific item.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronecargo.load.des: Move up to whole-number `count` units into this drone's cargo, retaining exact properties. Loads from the docked Drone Depot stockpile or a field Mining Drill after the drone finishes its route there. Hot cargo loads from a local Lead Cask and requires Shield Plating.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronecargo.load.pro: Optional property dict, matched as a subset by default. Omitted or `None` matches any properties; use `None` with `property_match="exact"` to select propertyless items only.
Optional selection mode: any, subset, or exact
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronecargo.space_fo: Free room for this specific material. **Each Cargo Pod holds one material**, so a pod counts only if it is empty or already holds `item_id`; the Bio Extractor's 25 t chamber counts only for life forms. Returns **0** for a material with no empty or matching pod, even while other pods still have room for their own materials.
Item id to size remaining room for
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronecargo.unload.d: Move up to whole-number `count` units from this drone's cargo into its docked Drone Depot, retaining exact properties. Hot cargo unloads into a compatible Lead Cask.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.dronecargo.unload.p: Optional property dict, matched as a subset by default. Omitted or `None` matches any properties; use `None` with `property_match="exact"` to select propertyless items only.
Optional selection mode: any, subset, or exact
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneoiltank.capaci: Total oil capacity in tons. Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have a heli powertrain.
Current oil in tons across mounted Oil Tanks. Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have a heli powertrain.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneoiltank.percen: Oil as a fraction **0-1**. Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have a heli powertrain.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.battery_ca: Electric drone charge capacity in Wh, or `None` for heli drones.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.battery_le: Electric drone charge fraction **0-1** when this ref was returned, or `None` for heli drones.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.battery_wh: Electric drone charge in Wh when this ref was returned, or `None` for heli drones.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.current_st: Station id when this ref was returned, or empty string.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.engine.des: `"electric"`, `"heli"`, or empty string if no thruster is mounted.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.id.descrip: Stable component id. Use with `get_component(id)` or pass it to Drone Service Station and Depot APIs.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.is_being_r: `True` if a Drone Service Station rescue was active for this drone when this ref was returned.
`True` if the drone was parked at a drone station when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.name.descr: Display name when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.oil_capaci: Heli drone oil capacity in tons, or `None` for electric drones.
Heli drone oil fraction **0-1** when this ref was returned, or `None` for electric drones.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.oil_tons.d: Heli drone oil in tons when this ref was returned, or `None` for electric drones.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.position.d: Position snapshot from when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.rescue_sta: Rescue status when this ref was returned: `"none"`, `"outbound"`, `"charging"`, `"carrying"`, or `"returning"`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.status.des: Activity/status string when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.x.descript: X coordinate in meters from base when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.droneref.y.descript: Y coordinate in meters from base when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.exoticdeposit.base_: Peak output rate during the active phase (t/h). Requires **wide** survey: returns `None` at basic.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.exoticdeposit.cap_i: Machine id of the currently deployed cap/tap, or empty string when none is present. Reads live. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.exoticdeposit.curre: The deposit's phase right now: `"active"` (emitting) or `"dormant"` (idle). Reads live: poll it from a held Site object and it follows the cycle. Returns `None` before the deposit is surveyed. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
Output rate right now (t/h: **0** during dormant). Reads live. Requires **wide** survey: returns `None` at basic. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.exoticdeposit.cycle: Duration of the active phase in minutes. Requires **deep** survey: returns `None` otherwise.
Duration of the dormant phase in minutes (rare deposits stay dormant longest). Requires **deep** survey: returns `None` otherwise.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.exoticdeposit.fluid: Fluid id this deposit emits, e.g. `"ammonia"` (common, usable direct) or `"raw_chlorine"` (rare, needs the Refiner). `None` until `surveyed`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.exoticdeposit.has_c: Boolean: `True` if an Exotic Gas Cap or Exotic Spring Tap is currently deployed on this deposit. Reads live. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.exoticdeposit.mediu: `"gas"` (tap with an **Exotic Gas Cap**) or `"liquid"` (tap with an **Exotic Spring Tap**). `None` until `surveyed`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.exoticdeposit.next_: Game-minutes until the next phase flip. Reads live: poll it in a control loop to act before dormancy hits. Requires **deep** survey: returns `None` otherwise. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.exoticdeposit.rarit: `"common"` emits the usable fluid with no refining; `"uncommon"` and `"rare"` emit a raw feedstock the Refiner converts with tar. Rarer deposits are sparser and stay dormant longer. `None` until `surveyed`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.exoticdeposit.surve: Highest survey tier achieved on this deposit: `"basic"` / `"wide"` / `"deep"`, or `None` if not yet surveyed. Reads live: a deeper re-survey upgrades held Site objects too. Higher tiers unlock more fields below. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fleet.drones.descri: All owned drones as read-only `DroneRef` snapshots. Use `.id` when passing a drone to station/recovery APIs; call `drones()` again for fresh ref fields, or `get_component(ref.id)` for the live drone API.
All owned vehicles and drones in one snapshot list. Use `.category` to branch between `"vehicle"` and `"drone"`; re-query for fresh positions/status.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fleet.vehicles.desc: All owned ground vehicles as read-only `VehicleRef` snapshots. Use `.id` when passing a vehicle to station APIs; call `vehicles()` again for fresh ref fields, or `get_component(ref.id)` for the live vehicle API.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidconnection.dec: Who owns the durable declaration: `"self"`, `"peer"`, or `"both"`. One side is sufficient for transport.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidconnection.flu: Exact fluid established by this relationship, or `None` while the relationship is neutral or incompatible.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidconnection.mac: Stable id of the peer machine.
Current display name of the peer machine.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidconnection.sta: Connection state: `"local"` for a direct same-outpost link; `"ready"` for a usable remote pipe network; `"unreachable"` when no completed component can be assigned; `"conflict"` when the assigned component carries different fluid connections; `"neutral"` before a fluid is known; or `"incompatible"` when the two fluids disagree.
Max tons this port's buffer can hold.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidport.connect.d: Record or replace this port's one declared target, using a stable machine id or display name. The target must expose a compatible opposite-direction port. Either the provider or consumer may declare the relationship; one declaration is enough. Local machines transfer directly, while remote intent waits for any completed conflict-free same-medium component reaching both anchors.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidport.connect.t: Stable id or display name of the provider or consumer
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidport.connected: Stable id of the target declared by this port, or empty string. `connect()` accepts an id or a display name, so compare against this when you need the identity to match what you passed: `connected_to()` answers with the renameable name. For every effective peer, including declarations owned by the other side, use `connections()`.
Display name of the target declared by this port, or empty string. It does not list compatible reverse declarations owned by peer ports.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidport.connectio: Read-only snapshots of every effective peer relationship on this port, including declarations authored by peer ports. Each `FluidConnection` reports the peer, exact fluid when known, declaration ownership, and structural state. Pipe ids are deliberately not exposed or selected.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidport.disconnec: Clear only this port's declared target. Buffered fluid remains. If the peer independently declared the same relationship, that reverse declaration remains active.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidport.flow_rate: Current total live flow in **t/h**. **0** may mean idle, starved, full, unreachable, conflicted, or waiting across a simulation timing boundary; it does not erase the connection or pipe identity.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fluidport.level.des: Current tons of fluid buffered at this port. Pass-through source ports such as Pump outputs store nothing and therefore read **0**.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fragmentlocation.ca: `True` if this fragment has already been analyzed and added to the Journal; `False` for still-unknown dots. Gates the optional `.fragment_id`, `.name`, and `.rarity` fields.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fragmentlocation.co: World coordinates `[x, y]` of this fragment. Pass to `bio_collector.collect(coords)` to retrieve.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fragmentlocation.di: Straight-line distance in meters from this outpost. Sorted ascending in the scan result: `result[0]` is the nearest.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fragmentlocation.fr: Known fragment id once `.cataloged` is `True`; `None` for still-unknown dots. Matches the keys in `BioOrder.requires`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fragmentlocation.na: Player-facing fragment name once `.cataloged` is `True`; `None` for still-unknown dots. Use for readable logs and UI-facing decisions while retaining `.fragment_id` as the stable automation key.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.fragmentlocation.ra: Rarity tier once `.cataloged` is `True`; `None` for still-unknown dots. Scan results never expose recipe or creature identity.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.guessresult.correct: Number of digits in the correct position.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.guessresult.misplac: Number of correct digits in wrong positions.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatbonusnode.ac: Whether this purchased node currently has at least one effect applying to the Habitat that returned it. Unpurchased nodes are always `False`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatbonusnode.lo: Minimum local colony population: **0** for the adaptation or **10,000** for the breakthrough.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatbonusnode.pu: Whether this node is permanently purchased.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatbonusnode.sc: Effect scope: `"species"` affects only `source_species`; `"global"` affects every current and future Habitat colony.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatbonusnode.so: Creature id whose tree owns this node. Global breakthroughs are still earned from one source species.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatbonusnode.un: All currently unmet requirements: at most `"population"` and `"insight"`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatbonustree.no: The species-only adaptation and all-species breakthrough in stable order, including locked and purchased nodes.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatbonustree.pu: Number of permanent nodes purchased from this species' tree.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatbonustree.sh: Exact shared Insight currently available for purchases, including retained fractions.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatbonustree.sp: Creature id whose authored tree is shown, or an empty string before a target is selected.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatinsight.life: Insight this colony has produced over its lifetime, including fractions.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatinsight.prod: Whether this colony is producing positive Insight at its current growth rate.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatinsight.rate: This colony's projected Insight production per hour at current growth and supply.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.habitatinsight.shar: Exact shared Insight currently spendable by any Habitat, including retained fractions.
Alias of `shared`, retained for scripts that already read the explicitly named exact balance.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.harvestingmachinere: Stable component id. Use with `get_component(id)` to reach the full Grow Lamp, Sprinkler, Dispenser, or Crop Automator API.
Display name when this ref was returned. Call `get_component(id)` for current machine state.
Harvesting-field sector occupied by the fixed machine, such as `"B22"`.
`True` when the machine's power toggle was on as this ref was returned. Call `get_component(id)` for live status and supply reads.
Fixed Harvesting-field machine type id: `"grow_lamp"`, `"sprinkler"`, `"dispenser"`, or `"crop_automator"`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.holder.batteries.de: List indexed by internal slot: each entry is a `PortableBattery` object, or `None` for an empty slot.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.holder.capacity.des: Rated Wh across every battery in this holder.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.holder.wh.descripti: Current Wh in this holder (pool level × rated capacity).
Maximum units this port's buffer can hold.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.connect.d: Set a compatible item source by stable id or display name. Two stationary endpoints must share an outpost. A Rover or Pioneer is reachable from any outpost, but only while it is parked inside this machine's service area. Field-extractor pickup outputs can be pulled only by a Rover or Pioneer. A drone's cargo moves through its Drone Depot. `"inventory"` is a freight source only while the endpoint is at Nocturna Base; remote stationary ports use local Storage Bins, Warehouses, or machine buffers.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.connect.n: Stable id or display name of a compatible item source, or inventory
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.connected: Stable id of the currently connected source, or empty string. `connect()` accepts an id or a display name, so compare against this when you need the identity to match what you passed: `connected_to()` answers with the renameable name.
Display name of the currently connected source, or empty string.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.count.des: Total units currently in this port's buffer.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.disconnec: Clear the current source connection. Does not move or discard buffered items; use `eject(...)` to recover them or `flush()` to destroy them.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.eject.des: Recover up to whole-number `count` units of `item_id` from this buffer without changing its source connection. Use `"inventory"` at Nocturna Base, or a compatible same-outpost store, machine input, or parked ground vehicle. Optional properties use the standard any, subset, or exact selection rules; exact item properties are preserved. Destination capacity may limit the move. Active or reserved work rejects without moving anything; a successful ejection cancels fractional work attached to the staged input. The transfer waits automatically for time proportional to units moved and requires Auto Feeders research.
Stable id or display name of a local compatible freight destination, or inventory
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.eject.pro: Optional property dict, matched as a subset by default. Omitted or `None` matches any properties; use `None` with `property_match="exact"` to select propertyless items only.
Optional selection mode: any, subset, or exact
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.flush.des: Permanently discard everything currently buffered in this input port. Flushed items are not returned to inventory. On processing machines, flushing also cancels any in-progress craft.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.stacks.de: Snapshot list of property-distinct `ItemStack` values currently buffered. Two entries may have the same id when their properties differ.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.take.desc: Take up to whole-number `count` units of `item_id` from the connected source. A property dict selects stacks containing that subset by default. Pass `"exact"` as the fourth argument for one full identity; `None, "exact"` selects only propertyless items. `"any"` ignores properties. Exact source properties are always retained. The transfer waits automatically for time proportional to units moved and requires Auto Feeders research.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.inputslot.take.prop: Optional property dict, matched as a subset by default. Omitted or `None` matches any properties; use `None` with `property_match="exact"` to select propertyless items only.
Optional selection mode: any, subset, or exact
api_reference.api.api_object_types.iteminfo.biome.desc: Native biome for a life form or biology sample; `None` when biome does not apply.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.iteminfo.category.d: Stable category used to distinguish materials, biological items, and equipment kinds.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.iteminfo.production: Lowest production tier that creates this item, or `None` when it is a raw, harvested, purchased, or otherwise source item. Smelter products are Tier 0.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.iteminfo.rarity.des: Rarity for a life form or biology sample; `None` when rarity does not apply.
`True` when multiple units share one inventory stack; `False` when each unit occupies its own slot.
Stable id of the item moved or destroyed, or `None` when no item changed.
Player-readable explanation of the item operation.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.itemresult.status.d: `"ok"`, `"empty"`, `"inventory_full"`, or `"invalid_slot"`, narrowed further by the command that returned it.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.itemstack.count.des: Whole-number units with this exact property identity.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.itemstack.id.descri: Stable item id shared by every unit in this stack.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.itemstack.propertie: Exact property dict for this item, or `None` for an ordinary commodity. Items with different properties form separate stacks and never merge.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.jobreceipt.job_id.d: Stable whole-number job id, or `None` when no job was created.
Player-readable explanation of the submission outcome.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.jobreceipt.queue_po: One-based execution position at submission time, including the active job, or `None` when rejected.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.jobreceipt.status.d: `"queued"` when the job entered the FIFO, otherwise the exact reason it was not accepted.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.latticecontract.gri: The alien deep-scan lattice. Probe only proven-clear cells to map the volatile nodes; a trip blocks further probes until the grid is reset. See LatticeGrid.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.latticecontract.rew: Credit reward for completing this contract.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.latticegrid.probe.d: Probe a proven clear whole-number cell. The reading is the whole-number count of neighboring volatile nodes in the **0-8** range. Tripping a node faults the lattice until `reset()` is called. Wrong argument types raise `TypeError`; fractional, non-finite, or out-of-bounds coordinates raise `ValueError` without tripping an intact lattice.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.latticegrid.reset.d: Clear a tripped fault so probing can continue in the same script run. The hidden board and guaranteed-clear starting cell do not change.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.latticegrid.start.d: A guaranteed-clear foothold cell, returned as `[x, y]`. Probe it first to get a reading and begin the deduction.
Player-readable explanation of the probe outcome.
Whole-number neighboring-node count in the **0-8** range when `.status == "ok"`; otherwise `None`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.lifeformsample.biom: Native biome this species belongs to: `"frozen"`, `"coastal"`, `"geothermal"`, `"volcanic"`, or `"deep"`. Fixed per species (never the terrain it grows on), and exactly the biome whose Essence Liquifier consumes it. Same value as `nocturna.life_form_biome(sample.type)`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.lifeformsample.rari: Rarity tier: `"common"`, `"uncommon"`, or `"rare"`. Determines both essence produced per ton at the Essence Liquifier and the cooldown after extraction.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.lifeformsample.rema: Tons currently available. Partial drone harvests reduce this; it returns to `.tons` after the coordinate's cooldown.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.lifeformsample.tons: Tons of this life-form available at the tile at scan time (peak value, not current state).
`[x, y]` whole-number coordinate of the scanned location.
`True` if no life forms found at this tile.
List of `LifeFormSample` entries: 0-3 items per tile. Empty list means "scanned, nothing here."
api_reference.api.api_object_types.loom.weave.descript: Braid two strings into one and return it. Each character is one token. Deterministic: the same inputs always weave the same way, so probe it freely. A non-string argument raises `TypeError`; either input longer than 30 characters raises `ValueError`. The loom only weaves forward; build the reverse yourself.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.marker.icon.descrip: Glyph drawn inside the marker pin, such as `"x"`, `"check"`, or `"hammer"`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.marker.id.descripti: Stable identity you passed to `markers.place(...)`. Pass it back to `markers.get(...)` or `markers.remove(...)`, and use its prefix to group families of markers.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.marker.label.descri: Display text shown on the map and in the Markers list. Empty string means the marker was placed without one, and the map shows its id instead.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.marker.note.descrip: Longer note shown when you hover the marker. Empty string means no note was written.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.marker.x.descriptio: World X coordinate in meters. Feed it straight to `self.nav.set_target(m.x, m.y)`, a drone `self.go_to(m.x, m.y)`, or `construction_blueprint.plan_structure(kind, m.x, m.y)`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.match.end.descripti: End character index for the group. Unmatched optional groups return `-1`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.match.group.descrip: Return the matched text for group `index`. Group `0` is the whole match. Optional groups that did not match return `None`; an out-of-range group raises.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.match.groups.descri: Return a tuple of captured groups, excluding group `0`. Groups that did not match use `default`, which is `None` if omitted.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.match.pattern.descr: The regular expression pattern string that produced this match.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.match.span.descript: Return `(start, end)` for the group. Unmatched optional groups return `(-1, -1)`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.match.start.descrip: Start character index for the group. Unmatched optional groups return `-1`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.miningsite.hardness: Hardness rating (**1-4**): gates drill compatibility. `None` until `surveyed`.
Item id this site yields when drilled (e.g. `"iron_ore"`, `"silicon"`). `None` until `surveyed`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mobileunitref.id.de: Stable component id. Use with `get_component(id)` or station APIs.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mobileunitref.is_be: `True` if a rescue/recovery mission owned this unit when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mobileunitref.is_do: `True` if the unit was parked at a service point/station when this ref was returned.
Unit type, e.g. `"rover"`, `"pioneer"`, or a drone chassis id.
Display name when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mobileunitref.posit: Position snapshot from when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mobileunitref.rescu: Rescue status when this ref was returned: `"none"`, `"outbound"`, `"charging"`, `"carrying"`, or `"returning"`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mobileunitref.statu: Activity/status string when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mobileunitref.x.des: X coordinate in meters from base when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mobileunitref.y.des: Y coordinate in meters from base when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mountslot.internal_: Number of internal slots this mounted module exposes. `0` for non-container modules.
List of item ids currently installed in this module's internal slots. `None` entries mark empty internal slots.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mountslot.module_id: Module id currently mounted in this slot, or `None` if empty.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.mountslot.type.desc: Slot's type: determines which modules fit (`nav`, `sonar_basic`, `drill_basic`, `universal`, `thruster`, or `drone_module`).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.navmodule.get_dista: Distance (meters) from the vehicle to the given point. Arrival loops need a tolerance, normally `> 2`, rather than exact zero. When the next action targets a building, route to its `BuildingRef.position`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.navmodule.get_posit: Vehicle position as a `Position` object with `.x` and `.y`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.navmodule.set_targe: Set target coordinates to drive toward.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.navmodule.speed_mul: Top-speed multiplier: **1.0** basic, or **1 + mounted Sport Nav count** on Pioneer. Speed only; range still depends on battery, throttle, cargo load, and movement draw.
Current throttle setpoint (**0.0-1.0**). Returns the value the script last wrote via `set_throttle(...)`. Distinct from `get_speed()`: `throttle()` is intent (does not change tick-to-tick); `get_speed()` is what the vehicle actually moved last tick.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.oilwell.flow_rate.d: Peak tons of oil per hour. **8 / 16 / 24** for standard / rich / pure. Oil wells pulse through active and dormant phases: a dormant well delivers nothing at any throttle (read the pump's `well_active()`). `None` until surveyed. Reads live, except on a pre-survey sonar result, which keeps returning `None`; obtain a new object after surveying.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.oilwell.has_pump.de: Boolean: `True` if an Oil Pump is currently deployed on this well. A pre-survey sonar result always returns `False`; obtain a new object after surveying for live readings.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.oilwell.pump_id.des: Current machine id of the Oil Pump deployed on this well, or empty string when no pump is present. A pre-survey sonar result always returns empty string; obtain a new object after surveying for live readings.
One of `"standard"` (**1×**) / `"rich"` (**2×**) / `"pure"` (**3×**). `None` until surveyed. Checks current survey progress, except on a pre-survey sonar result, which keeps returning `None`; obtain a new object after surveying.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.order.contractor_id: Id of the issuing contractor, or `None` for Weekly Earth Orders. Stable across saves and useful for branching on specific campaign partners.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.order.contractor_na: Pre-translated issuing contractor name, or `None` for Weekly Earth Orders.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.order.expires_day.d: Day when a Weekly Earth Order expires, or `None` for contractor campaign orders.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.order.id.descriptio: Immutable Earth Order id. Useful for logs and dashboards; Supply Dock scripts use it to identify the order currently assigned to their dock.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.order.name.descript: Pre-translated display name of the Earth Order.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.order.requires.desc: Dict `{item_id: count}` of what Earth is demanding. Use `.keys()`, `.values()`, `.items()`, or index directly: `order.requires["iron_ore"]`.
Pre-translated description of the variable reward, or `None` for credits-only Earth Orders.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.order.shipped.descr: Dict `{item_id: count}` of how many units of each item have already landed. Use `.get(item_id, 0)` to read safely.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpost.buildings.d: Fresh list of `BuildingRef` snapshots: one entry per building deployed here. Pass a `type_id` (e.g. `"storage_bin"`) to filter, or omit for every building. Each ref carries `.id` / `.name` / `.type_id` / `.outpost` / `.powered` / `.position`: for type-specific live reads (`count()`, `material()`, `recipe`, etc.) call `get_component(ref.id)` to reach the full component API.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpost.buildings.t: Optional. Machine type id to filter by (e.g. "storage_bin"). Omit to return every building at this outpost.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpost.buildings_c: Soft building threshold at this outpost. Each counted building above it reduces productive and service throughput. Nocturna Base has a few extra starter slots; founded outposts use the standard threshold.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpost.buildings_u: Number of buildings deployed at this outpost. Sensors, mobile units, structural hubs, and POI extraction don't count.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpost.coords.desc: World coordinates of the outpost anchor as `[x, y]`. Home outpost sits at `[0, 0]`; founded outposts carry the position chosen in Plan mode.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpost.harvesting_: Fresh list of `HarvestingMachineRef` snapshots for fixed machines deployed on this outpost's Harvesting field. Currently only the home outpost, Nocturna Base, has that field, so founded outposts return an empty list. Includes Grow Lamps, Sprinklers, Dispensers, and Crop Automators, which occupy field cells but do not use building capacity or appear in `buildings()`. It does not include the mobile Harvester, crops, loose items, Water Wells, or other POI extractors. Pass a `type_id` to filter, or omit it for all four fixed machine types. Use `get_component(ref.id)` for type-specific live reads.
Optional fixed Harvesting-field machine type id: `"grow_lamp"`, `"sprinkler"`, `"dispenser"`, or `"crop_automator"`. Omit it to return every fixed machine deployed on the field.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpost.id.descript: Immutable instance id (e.g. `"outpost_home"`, `"outpost_1"`). Stable for the life of the save: use this in scripts that need to outlive renames.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpost.is_full.des: Returns `True` when this outpost has reached or exceeded its soft building threshold. The threshold itself does not block ordinary deployment.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpost.is_home.des: Returns `True` when this is the home outpost (default name `"Nocturna Base"`).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpost.name.descri: Display name. Defaults to `"Nocturna Base"` for the home outpost or a generated `"Outpost N"` name for founded outposts; freely renameable from the Computer System tab. Mutable: prefer `id` when persistence matters.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostnetwork.home: The home outpost as an `OutpostRef` snapshot.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostnetwork.near: Nearest owned outpost to the given world coordinate as an `OutpostRef` snapshot.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostnetwork.outp: All owned outposts as read-only `OutpostRef` snapshots, including home. Use `.id` when passing an outpost to another API; call `outposts()` again when you need fresh counts/names.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostref.biome.de: Biome this outpost sits in: one of `"frozen"`, `"coastal"`, `"geothermal"`, `"volcanic"`, `"deep"`. Derived from the outpost's location. A building reaches its own biome via `self.outpost.biome`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostref.building: Fresh list of `BuildingRef` snapshots: one entry per building deployed here. Pass a `type_id` (e.g. `"storage_bin"`) to filter, or omit for every building. Each ref carries `.id` / `.name` / `.type_id` / `.outpost` / `.powered` / `.position`: for type-specific live reads (`count()`, `material()`, `recipe`, etc.) call `get_component(ref.id)` to reach the full component API.
Optional. Machine type id to filter by (e.g. "storage_bin"). Omit to return every building at this outpost.
Soft building threshold at this outpost when this ref was returned. Buildings above it reduce productive and service throughput.
Buildings deployed at this outpost when this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostref.coords.d: Top-left anchor of the outpost footprint as `[x, y]`. Use `buildings()` and `BuildingRef.position` when routing to a particular service building.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostref.harvesti: Fresh list of `HarvestingMachineRef` snapshots for fixed machines deployed on this outpost's Harvesting field. Currently only the home outpost, Nocturna Base, has that field, so founded outposts return an empty list. Includes Grow Lamps, Sprinklers, Dispensers, and Crop Automators, which occupy field cells but do not use building capacity or appear in `buildings()`. It does not include the mobile Harvester, crops, loose items, Water Wells, or other POI extractors. Pass a `type_id` to filter, or omit it for all four fixed machine types. Use `get_component(ref.id)` for type-specific live reads.
Optional fixed Harvesting-field machine type id: `"grow_lamp"`, `"sprinkler"`, `"dispenser"`, or `"crop_automator"`. Omit it to return every fixed machine deployed on the field.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostref.id.descr: Immutable outpost id, e.g. `"outpost_home"` or `"outpost_1"`. Use it with `get_component(id)` or APIs that need a stable target.
`True` when this outpost had reached or exceeded its soft building threshold at the time this ref was returned. The threshold itself does not block ordinary deployment.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostref.name.des: Display name at the time this ref was returned.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostref.position: Top-left anchor of the outpost footprint as a `Position` snapshot. This identifies the outpost, not a particular building's docking point.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostref.x.descri: World X coordinate of the outpost footprint's top-left anchor, in meters from base. For an at-building action, route to that building's `BuildingRef.position` instead.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outpostref.y.descri: World Y coordinate of the outpost footprint's top-left anchor, in meters from base. For an at-building action, route to that building's `BuildingRef.position` instead.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outputslot.capacity: Maximum units this port's buffer can hold.
Set a compatible item destination by stable id or display name. Two stationary endpoints must share an outpost. A Rover or Pioneer is reachable from any outpost, but only while it is parked inside this machine's service area. A drone's cargo moves through its Drone Depot. `"inventory"` is a freight destination only while the endpoint is at Nocturna Base; remote stationary ports use local Storage Bins, Warehouses, or machine inputs.
Stable id or display name of a compatible item destination, or inventory
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outputslot.connecte: Stable id of the currently connected target, or empty string. `connect()` accepts an id or a display name, so compare against this when you need the identity to match what you passed: `connected_to()` answers with the renameable name.
Display name of the currently connected target, or empty string.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outputslot.count.de: Total units currently in this port's buffer.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outputslot.disconne: Clear the current target connection. Does not move or discard buffered output.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outputslot.send.des: Send up to whole-number `count` units of `item_id` to the connected target. A property dict selects stacks containing that subset by default. Pass `"exact"` as the fourth argument for one full identity; `None, "exact"` selects only propertyless items. `"any"` ignores properties. Exact source properties are preserved. The transfer waits automatically for time proportional to units moved and requires Auto Feeders research.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outputslot.send.pro: Optional property dict, matched as a subset by default. Omitted or `None` matches any properties; use `None` with `property_match="exact"` to select propertyless items only.
Optional selection mode: any, subset, or exact
api_reference.api.api_object_types.outputslot.stacks.d: Snapshot list of property-distinct `ItemStack` values currently buffered. Use `.properties` to inspect and select variants before `send()`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.panel.counter.label: Optional label
Optional numeric font size in pixels (default 24)
api_reference.api.api_object_types.panel.draw_circle.c: Theme token, or any CSS color (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, named).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.panel.draw_icon.ite: Item id to draw the icon for
api_reference.api.api_object_types.panel.draw_line.col: Theme token, or any CSS color (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, named).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.panel.draw_rect.col: Theme token, or any CSS color (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, named).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.panel.draw_text.col: Theme token, or any CSS color (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, named).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.panel.fill_circle.c: Theme token, or any CSS color (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, named).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.panel.fill_rect.col: Theme token, or any CSS color (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, named).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.panel.pill.color.de: Theme token (e.g. `"accent"`), or any CSS color (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, named).
Theme token, or any CSS color (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, named).
Theme token, or any CSS color (hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, named).
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pickupoutputslot.ca: Maximum item units this pickup stockpile can hold.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pickupoutputslot.co: Total item units waiting for carrier pickup.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pickupoutputslot.st: Snapshot list of property-distinct `ItemStack` values waiting for carrier pickup.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.conflicting_co: Sorted exact substances established by complete provider-consumer connections when more than one uses this physical component, or an empty list. A non-empty result means flow is halted.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.connections.de: Diagnostic machine-port claims established on this physical component. Each dictionary contains `machine_id`, `port`, `direction`, `fluid`, and a representative `pipe_id` from the component; players never connect to that pipe id directly.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.contents.descr: The one exact fluid established by complete player connections whose locations this physical component reaches, such as `"steam"`, `"water"`, or `"oil"`. Returns `None` when there is no complete connection or multiple exact substances conflict. Activity, power, throttle, flow, and headroom do not change this identity.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.end.descriptio: Geometric end coordinate of this pipe piece as a `Position`. This is construction geometry, not flow direction. Returns `None` only if malformed state contains no segment geometry.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.flow_rate.desc: Tons per world hour (`t/h`) currently moving through the pipe. **0** while incomplete, stalled, source-empty, or conflicted. Live read.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.incompatible_s: Ids of directly connected consumers that cannot accept `contents()`. Those consumers receive nothing, while compatible branches continue flowing. Live read.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.is_complete.de: Boolean: `True` once the Constructor has finished laying the pipe and flow can run. Live read.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.laying_head.de: `[x, y]` coordinates of the current laying head while incomplete, or `None` once complete. Live read.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.length.descrip: Total length of the pipe in meters, summed over every H/V segment.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.start.descript: Geometric start coordinate of this pipe piece as a `Position`. This is construction geometry, not flow direction. Returns `None` only if malformed state contains no segment geometry.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.state.descript: Current pipe state: one of `"flowing"` / `"stalled"` / `"incomplete"` / `"no_source"` / `"conflict"`. Live read.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pipe.type.descripti: Pipe hardware medium: `"gas"` or `"liquid"`. Use `contents()` for the exact substance established by complete provider-consumer connections.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.planet.id.descripti: Planet id: pass this to transmitter.connect().
api_reference.api.api_object_types.plantrequirement.ki: Cultivation condition: `"light"`, `"shade"`, `"water"`, `"salt"`, `"spacer"`, `"cluster"`, `"companion"`, or `"antagonist"`. Every entry in `SeedRecipe.requirements` is required; combined species expose multiple entries.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.plantrequirement.sp: Related species key for relational conditions: the required neighbor for `"companion"`, or the forbidden neighbor for `"antagonist"`. `None` for all other kinds.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pointofinterest.kin: What the contact is: but **`"unknown"` until `.scanned` is True**. Once scanned it reads `"mineral"`, `"biomass"`, `"thermal"`, `"water"`, `"oil"`, `"exotic"`, or `"inert"`. You can't tell an ore deposit from a biosite from orbit; scanning is what reveals the type, so route a scanner to each unknown and find out.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pointofinterest.sca: `True` once you've resolved this contact: a Rover/Pioneer sonar **survey** for a productive non-biomass site, a drone **bio-scan** that logged life at a biomass site, or a sonar **scan** that discovered an inert contact. `False` is your work list: the "?" is still unidentified. Filter `if not p.scanned:` to find the sites left to visit.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pointofinterest.x.d: Whole-number X coordinate (meters from base) of this contact. Pass straight to a Rover/Pioneer `self.nav.set_target(p.x, p.y)` or a drone `self.go_to(p.x, p.y)`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.pointofinterest.y.d: Whole-number Y coordinate (meters from base) of this contact.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.portablebioextracto: Yielding harvest at the discovered permanent biosite under a hovering drone. The drone stays occupied until completion, including across a script stop and restart. The module has a 25 t chamber for one life-form type; Cargo Pods add capacity. Partial depletion persists and cooldown starts only when the site is empty.
Yielding scan at the hovering drone's current whole-number coordinate. A valid non-site coordinate completes with an empty biological scan. Repeat scans are free.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.position._iter_.des: Iterate over `x`, then `y`, so this position can be unpacked or passed to `list()`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.position.x.descript: X coordinate in meters from base for this position snapshot.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.position.y.descript: Y coordinate in meters from base for this position snapshot.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.proberesult.distanc: Whole-number Manhattan distance (steps) to the nearest message cell. 0 means this cell IS a message cell.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.rack.bins.descripti: List indexed by internal slot: each entry is a `Bin` object, or `None` for an empty slot.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.receiveresult.messa: Player-readable explanation of the receive outcome.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.receiveresult.packe: The consumed `CommsMessage` when `status == "ok"`, otherwise `None`. When a message id was requested, this packet has that exact id.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.receiveresult.statu: `"ok"` when a queued message was consumed; `"empty"` when no id was requested and the queue was empty; `"not_found"` when the requested id was absent; or `"invalid_channel"` for an invalid channel id.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.byproduct_co: Units of `byproduct_item` produced per run; **0** for recipes with no byproduct.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.byproduct_it: Item id of the byproduct, or `None` if this recipe has no byproduct.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.duration_gam: Base cycle duration in hours at full efficiency, with inputs, power and output space available. Overcrowding and blocked output can extend actual completion time.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.fluid_inputs: Dict `{port_name: tons_per_run}` of fluid consumed when one run completes (`"water_in"` etc.). Empty dict for recipes with no fluid input.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.fluid_output: Dict `{port_name: tons_per_run}` of fluid deposited when one run completes. Empty dict for item-output recipes; Refiner recipes identify `gas_out` or `liquid_out` here.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.id.descripti: Recipe id (e.g. `"smelt_iron_ingot"`). Stable across saves: use to compare recipes or pass back to `set_recipe(...)`.
Concrete fluid id required by a generic input port, or `None` when the port itself already identifies the fluid. Refiner recipes use this to distinguish raw feedstocks on `gas_in` / `liquid_in`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.inputs.descr: Dict `{item_id: count}` of materials consumed per run. Iterate via `.keys()`, `.values()`, `.items()`, or index: `recipe.inputs["iron_ore"]`.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.name.descrip: Pre-translated display name of the recipe.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.output_count: Amount of `output_item` produced per run: whole units for an item or tons for a fluid.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.output_fluid: Concrete fluid id produced through a generic output port, or `None` for item-output recipes. Equal to `output_item` for current fluid-only Refiner recipes.
Product id produced per run: an item id for discrete recipes or a fluid id for fluid-output recipes such as the Refiner.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.power_draw.d: Watts the machine draws while this recipe is running.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.recipe.tier.descrip: Derived production tier. Smelter foundations are Tier 0; every other recipe is one tier above its deepest manufactured input.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.relayhackcontract.r: Credit reward for completing this contract.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.relaylock.intercept: Candidate list of 6 whole numbers, each 0-99

Test a list of exactly 6 whole-number values in the **0-99** range and return one True/False value per tumbler. Wrong argument types raise `TypeError`; wrong list length, non-finite or fractional values, and values outside the range raise `ValueError`.
Whole-number credits earned by this sale.
Stable item id requested for sale.
Player-readable explanation of the sale outcome.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.scanresult.id.descr: Item ID at the scanned sector (empty string if nothing).
Player-readable explanation of the scan or collection outcome.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.scanresult.status.d: Stable outcome code. Scanner results use `"ok"` / `"empty"`; Harvester results can also report `"holding"`, `"overheated"`, `"moving"` (in transit), `"busy"` (occupied by another action), or `"collecting"`.
JSON-safe argument dict sent with the command. Use `.get(key, default)` for optional arguments.
api_reference.api.api_object_types.scriptcommand.creat: Creation bookkeeping value: a supplied real-world timestamp in milliseconds, otherwise the enqueueing simulation tick, or **0** when neither was supplied. For gameplay timing, use `.tick`.
